versions.changelog:
Initial public release of pywayne-bin-gettool.

- Fetch and install C++ tools/libraries (e.g., eigen, opencv, pcl, fmt) from cpp_tools repository.
- Supports listing, fetching, and cloning tools; optional building (with CMake/make) and installation scripts.
- Allows custom target paths, clean copy (src/include only), and fetching specific versions/tags (for submodules).
- Includes management of cpp_tools repository URL.
- Command-line interface with flags for all key operations.
